title: Riendzo Ra Moya Lowu Amukeriweke
intro: Hi nkarhi lowu mimpimanyeto ya vaaki a yi ri ni matimba, munhu wo hlawuleka u ve ni ku cinca lokukulu endzeni ka ndyangu lowu katekisiweke. Mhaka ya vona, leyi funghiweke hi xiboho xa rirhandzu ni xileriso xa Xikwembu, yi kombisa ku tshoveka ka mindhavuko ya khale ni ku simekiwa ka misinya ya milawu leyintshwa, leyi lulameke. Xitlhokovetselo lexi xi kombisa nkoka wa ntiyiso ku tlula ntwanano na vutlhari lebyi nga endzhaku ka swileriso swa Allah.
clues: Ndzi tshame ndzi va mubohiwa, kambe hi ku tirhisa malunghiselelo ya Xikwembu, ndzi kume kaya ni ndyangu lowuntshwa.
A ndzi rhandziwa swinene lerova loko ndzi nyikiwe ku hlawula exikarhi ka ndyangu wa mina wa xiviri ni muhlayisi wa mina la amukeriweke, ndzi hlawule ku tshama ni loyi wo hetelela.
Vito ra mina ri tshame ri fambisana ni muhlayisi wa mina la amukeriweke, ku nga mukhuva lowu a wu tolovelekile evanhwini ra ka hina.
Hi mina ntsena munghana wa Muprofeta wo hetelela loyi vito ra yena ri boxiweke hi ku kongoma hi Allah eka Quran.
Ndzi tekile wansati wa xiyimo xa le henhla loyi a ri muzala wa Muprofeta, kambe vukati bya hina a byi nga tshami nkarhi wo leha.
Endzhaku ka ku dlaya ka mina vukati, Allah hi byakwe u lerise leswaku khale ka nsati wa mina u ta teka Muprofeta, xisweswo a herisa mukhuva wa khale malunghana ni ku amukela n’wana.

identity.answer: Zayd ibn Harithah, loyi a nga ni vuxiyaxiya

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
